articles.title: Atmanirbhar Villages: Empowering India’s Journey Towards Self-Reliance
articles.summary: Atmanirbhar Bharat is a visionary Indian policy promoting self-reliance by empowering citizens, strengthening local industries, and advancing digital solutions. It boosts domestic manufacturing, fosters innovation, and reduces import dependency. This initiative aims to drive economic growth, create jobs, and enhance India's strategic autonomy and global competitiveness.

articles.title: Assam CM Sarma inaugurates Guwahati Science City in Sonapur
articles.summary: Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma formally inaugurated the Guwahati Science City at Tepesia, Sonapur. This significant new facility is aimed at promoting science education and fostering a scientific temper across the state of Assam. It marks a crucial step in enhancing scientific literacy and innovation among students and the wider public, underscoring the government's commitment to scientific development.

articles.title: Infiltration bid foiled, Pak ultra gunned down in Rajouri
articles.summary: Indian security forces successfully thwarted an infiltration attempt in Jammu and Kashmir's Rajouri district. During the operation, a Pakistani militant attempting to cross into Indian territory was intercepted and neutralized. This incident highlights the continuous vigilance and effective counter-infiltration measures undertaken by Indian troops to maintain national security and combat cross-border terrorism in sensitive border regions.

articles.title: US-Israel-Iran war: Casualty figures from across Middle East
articles.summary: US and Israel launched strikes on Iran on February 28, escalating conflict across the Middle East. This has led to the spread of war and numerous casualties reported in various regional countries. The situation highlights significant geopolitical tensions and ongoing instability, impacting peace and security throughout the area.

articles.title: It Takes Years To Refuel A Nuclear Submarine - Here's Why
articles.summary: Maintaining nuclear-powered surface ships, including aircraft carriers, involves extensive and costly Refueling Complex Overhaul (RCOH) processes. These crucial operations are neither cheap nor quick, with examples like the USS George requiring $2.8 billion for refuelling and retrofitting. This underscores the significant financial and logistical commitments necessary for the upkeep of advanced nuclear naval assets.
